title: smoke test: psp-etl ingest
description: Write tests/test_cli_ingest.py. The ingest command has zero CLI-level tests. Use unittest.mock.patch('psp_etl.ingest.PSPTool') to mock PSPTool.from_file (see existing tests/test_ingest.py for the mock pattern). Tests must cover: (1) happy path: invoke CLI with a tmp fake ROM, verify exit 0, entry created in DB, blob written to data/blobs/. (2) directory input: pass a directory with multiple .rom files. (3) corrupt ROM: PSPTool raises, expect parse_errors row inserted and exit 0. (4) duplicate ROM: re-ingesting same ROM is idempotent (no duplicate entries). All tests use --data-dir tmp_path.
